title: 輪の中でも変わらずに

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's lunchtime, and I notice that one corner of the cafeteria is particularly noisy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Doberrrr! Lemme have a taste of your strawberry one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No. If you remember, the last time you asked for "a taste," you went and ate all of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Blow… Blow…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pearl, stop! STOP! My horoscope was very clear! I'm lucky as long as I avoid sunglasses in motion! So, kindly STOP!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Fukukitaru, let me just say this: the only one who can throw me off my groove is me…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mm hmmmm!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaggghhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Munch… Munch, munch…
choice_data_list: I'm impressed you can eat with all this going on.
I'm impressed you can eat with all this going on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good day to you, Trainer. This requires more effort than you may think, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Blowing on the hot food to cool it has left me rather parched.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …It seems Mejiro Bright is so focused on her grilled carrot that she hasn't noticed the circus unfolding around her.
choice_data_list: You're steady no matter what, huh?
You're steady no matter what, huh?
Would you like something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …It seems Mejiro Bright is so focused on her grilled carrot that she hasn't noticed the circus unfolding around her.
choice_data_list: You're steady no matter what, huh?
You're steady no matter what, huh?
Would you like something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Did you mean to say "calm"?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Bright! Wanna go threesies on Dober's strawberry ice cream?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Taiki! Don't bring Bright into this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'm still eating my grilled carrot, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Please extend another invitation once I've finished my meal, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bright! Assist me in halting Pearl's nonsensical dance number! Please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Very well. Once I've finished my meal, I shall lend you a hand. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Blow… Blow… …

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Blow… Blow…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ack?! I foresee this taking eons!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Mejiro Bright remains unfazed and finishes her lunch at her own pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much! I could go for a nice cup of tea…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why, yes. My throat's a little dry, that's all.
choice_data_list: I'll go grab that tea for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the cafeteria's drink bar and pour her a cup of tea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Figuring that something cold might be a good idea, I grab some water as well. When I arrive back at the table, however…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Great stars! That cup you hold! Could it be?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oopsie! You already had your trainer grabbin' a drink, huh, Bright?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Oh dear. I brought one for her too. I should have asked first.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Looks like all our true colors came out at once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Mejiro Bright's table is now lined with drinks her friends brought over.
choice_data_list: It seems like everyone really loves you.
It seems like everyone really loves you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'd say it's more that everyone is very kind-hearted than that I'm a figure of adoration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That said, one person could hardly drink all this by herself…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why don't we have an impromptu tea party right now? It can be calm, comfortable, and carefree. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by her friends, Mejiro Bright enjoys not only her lunch but her spontaneous tea party as well, all at her own pace.
